posts.title: The Last Outpost
posts.description: The last outpost of humanity against the AI takeover is literature. But not the literature of the mundane, non-fiction. I’m talking about fiction. Yes, human fiction. Imagination. Angels and demons that inhabit the human soul. Written fiction is a projection of human feelings from a certain point in time, lifetime. An afflicted human would build […]

posts.title: Honesty
posts.description: Stumbled upon this fragment built by Grok today. Brutal honesty. Most people are not special, rational, or particularly good. They’re tribal primates running social scripts, ranking status, and defending comforting lies over evidence. Intelligence, drive, and outcomes are heavily genetic. Equality of result is a fantasy.
